subject: Installation from "no-su" branch periodically becomes unresponsive

messages.author: b31b6772a245d91f
messages.subject: Installation from "no-su" branch periodically becomes unresponsive
parts:
We are currently running the most recent revision (from Apr 23, 2013) of the "no-su" branch of shiny-server, from here:

https://github.com/jcheng5/shiny-server/tree/no-su

We're having a problem that may be specific to the "no-su" branch, where shiny-server frequently becomes unresponsive and needs to be restarted. This only started happening recently. It was working just fine for about a week, but now it has to be restarted about once a day and has done this for the past four days.

We haven't found anything in the server log or the individual app logs that seems to indicate what the problem is. Any ideas? Is there any more information we can provide that will help figure this out or replicate the problem?

Thanks!
Craig

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Installation from "no-su" branch periodically becomes unresponsive
parts:
Do you know whether it's the server itself that's becoming unresponsive, or the R process that's actually hosting the Shiny app?

When it goes unresponsive can you try hitting the "/ping" URL and see if it returns OK or just hangs?

Also can you show me what top shows for VIRT, RES, and SHR for the node process? (top -p `pidof node`)

Thanks.
